title: TikTok
description: Supernerd was hired to Art Direct the creation of a website for TikTok during COVID social distancing, it was to serve as an event for Black History month highlighting their black creators on the app. This app would serve as a means to watch live performances, learn information about black history, and be a chat ground for its content creators. Jump in to see how we created a virtual world using equirectangular renders to create a 360 degree website.
